```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(scuttle)
library(Seurat)
library(pheatmap)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)
library(scCustomize)
library(stringr)
library(slingshot)
library(monocle3)

T8 <- readRDS("~/R/T8.rds")
T8tum <- subset(T8, subset = tissue == "tumor")
T8LN <- subset(T8, subset = tissue == "LN")


col_T8 = c(
  "Tcentral mem(1)" =  "#edba40",
  "Tearly act(1)" = "#e28c33",
  "Teff(1)"  = "#e0652b",
  "Tcentral mem(2)" = "#AED140",
  "Tearly act(2)" =  "#2DA049",
  "Teff(2)" = "#1D6517",
  "Tlate act" = "#a9725A",
  "Teff(3)" = "#009688",
  "Tcytotoxic" =  "#00bcd4", 
  "Texh(1)"= "#03a9f4" ,
  "Texh(2)" = "#2196f3",
  "Texh(3)" = "#3f51b5",
  "Texh(4)" = "#673ab7" ,
  "Tprolif" = "#9c27b0",
  "Tmisc"= "#788176", 
  "Tc17/MAIT" = "#f44336"
) 

colorblind_vector <- colorRampPalette(rev(c("#0D0887FF", # single
                                            "#7301A8FF", # small
                                            "#BD3786FF", # medium
                                            "#ED7953FF", # large
                                            "#FDC926FF", # hyperexp
                                            "#F0F921FF")))# ultraexp

colorblind_vector_tum <- colorRampPalette(rev(c("#7301A8FF", # small
                                            "#BD3786FF", # medium
                                            "#ED7953FF", # large
                                            "#FDC926FF", # hyperexp
                                            "#F0F921FF")))# ultraexp

colorblind_vector_locexp <- colorRampPalette(rev(c("#7301A8FF", # small
                                                "#BD3786FF", # medium
                                                "#ED7953FF", # large
                                               "#FDC926FF", # hyperexp
                                            "#F0F921FF")))# ultraexp

colorblind_vector_sh <- colorRampPalette(rev(c("#7301A8FF", # small
                                                "#BD3786FF", # medium
                                                "#ED7953FF", # large
                                               "#FDC926FF"))) # hyperexp
```




## Figure 4 - upset plot settings

```{r upset settings}
metadata <-  as.data.frame(T8@meta.data)
# Create a new data frame to store the binary values
binary_matrix <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(metadata), ncol = length(levels(metadata$CD8.Cell.Types))))

# Set column names based on the levels of CD8.Cell.Types
colnames(binary_matrix) <- levels(metadata$CD8.Cell.Types)

# Populate the binary matrix
for (i in 1:length(levels(metadata$CD8.Cell.Types))) {
  binary_matrix[, i] <- metadata$CD8.Cell.Types == levels(metadata$CD8.Cell.Types)[i]
}

# Convert TRUE/FALSE to 1/0
binary_matrix <- as.data.frame(lapply(binary_matrix, as.integer))

# Add the binary matrix columns to the original metadata data frame
metadata <- cbind(metadata, binary_matrix)

# set CD8 Cell Types levels as cluster
cluster = colnames(metadata[c(97:112)])
# create table 'clones' with all labeled clones (Clonotype_2) with the distribution over the cell clusters 
clones <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(metadata$Clonotype_2, metadata$CD8.Cell.Types))
cluster = colnames(clones)

```


## Fig 4A1 - Pseudotime trajectory analysis - slingshot
```{r slingshot}
data <- T8

# Save the objects as separate matrices for input in slingshot
dimred <- data@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
clustering <- data$CD8.Cell.Types
counts <- as.matrix(data@assays$RNA@counts[data@assays$RNA@var.features, ])


# Run default Slingshot lineage identification
#set.seed(1)
lineages <- getLineages(data = dimred, clusterLabels = clustering)
lineages <- as.SlingshotDataSet(lineages)


# Plot the lineages
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
#plot(dimred[, 1:2], col = mycolors[clustering], cex = 0.5, pch = 16)
plot(dimred[, 1:2], col = col_T8[clustering], cex = 0.5, pch = 16)
for (i in levels(clustering)) {
  text(mean(dimred[clustering == i, 1]), mean(dimred[clustering == i, 2]), labels = i, font = 2)
}
#plot(dimred[, 1:2], col = mycolors[clustering], cex = 0.5, pch = 16)
plot(dimred[, 1:2], col = col_T8[clustering], cex = 0.5, pch = 16)
lines(lineages, lwd = 1, col = "black")

```


## Fig 4A2 - Pseudotime trajectory analysis - monocle
```{r monocle3}
T8small <- subset(T8, downsample = 5000)

cds <- SeuratWrappers::as.cell_data_set(T8small)
cds <- cluster_cells(cds, resolution = 1e-4, reduction_method = 'UMAP')

cds <- learn_graph(cds, use_partition = F, verbose = T)
cds <- order_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")

## OR
cds <-  readRDS("~/R/cds1e4.rds") # load the cds object with resolution 1e-4
cds_order_1 <- order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes='Y_1', reduction_method = "UMAP")


p1 <- plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "cluster", show_trajectory_graph = FALSE)
p2 <- plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "partition", show_trajectory_graph = FALSE)
wrap_plots(p1, p2)

plot_cells(cds_order_1,
           color_cells_by = "pseudotime",
           label_cell_groups=FALSE,
           label_leaves=FALSE,
           label_branch_points=FALSE,
           graph_label_size=1.5,
           trajectory_graph_segment_size =2,
           trajectory_graph_color = "black", # black line
           alpha = 0.7,
           rasterize = T) + # cells more transparent 
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "C",      # Or "D" for standard viridis
    begin = 0.25,       # Starts the color map at a lighter value (removes black/dark blue)
    end = 1,         # Ends slightly before pure yellow for better contrast
    na.value = "white" # Keeps out-of-range cells light and visible
  )

```

## Figure 4B - Upset plot clusters related to exhausted clusters
```{r clones and exhaustion}
metadata2 <- metadata %>%
  filter(Frequency_2 >1) #%>%
 # filter(tissue == "tumor")
clones <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(metadata2$Clonotype_2, metadata2$CD8.Cell.Types))
cluster = colnames(clones)

clones_exh <- clones %>%
  filter(`Texh(1)`>0 | `Texh(2)`>0 | `Texh(3)`>0 | `Texh(4)`>0)

upset(clones_exh, cluster, name='cluster combination',
      n_intersections = 20, # top 20 van voorkomende intersections
      width_ratio=0.1,
      wrap = T) + 
  ggtitle("Top 20 intersections of clones related to Texh cells")


```

## Figure 4E2 - number of clones per shared/loc exp per tissue
```{r}

## loc exp number of clones for stacked bar plot
df <- T8locexp@meta.data %>%
  select(patient_true, tissue, Clonotype_2, cloneType_2)
result <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(patient_true)) %>%  # Remove rows with NA in patient_true
  group_by(tissue, cloneType_2) %>%
  summarise(unique_clones = n_distinct(Clonotype_2), .groups = "drop") %>%  # Count unique clonotypes per tissue
  arrange( tissue, cloneType_2)  # Optional: sort for readability
# View result
View(result)
# write.csv(result, 'CD8locexp.clonetype.per.tissue.csv')


## shared number of clones for stacked bar plot
df <- T8locexp@meta.data %>%
  select(patient_true, tissue, Clonotype_2, cloneType_2)
result <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(patient_true)) %>%  # Remove rows with NA in patient_true
  group_by(tissue, cloneType_2) %>%
  summarise(unique_clones = n_distinct(Clonotype_2), .groups = "drop") %>%  # Count unique clonotypes per tissue
  arrange( tissue, cloneType_2)  # Optional: sort for readability
# View result
View(result)
# write.csv(result, 'CD8shared.clonetype.per.tissue.csv')

```

## Figure 4G1 - Route 1 and 2 highlighted in UMAP
```{r, route 1 and route 2 on UMAP}

Idents(T8) <- "CD8.Cell.Types"
Tearly1LN <- WhichCells(object = T8LN, idents = "Tearly act(1)")
Teff1LN <- WhichCells(object = T8LN, idents = "Teff(1)")
Tearly2LN <- WhichCells(object = T8LN, idents = "Tearly act(2)")
Teff2LN <- WhichCells(object = T8LN, idents = "Teff(2)")

Tearly1t <- WhichCells(object = T8tum, idents = "Tearly act(1)")
Teff1t <- WhichCells(object = T8tum, idents = "Teff(1)")
Tearly2t <- WhichCells(object = T8tum, idents = "Tearly act(2)")
Teff2t <- WhichCells(object = T8tum, idents = "Teff(2)")


route1LN <- list("Tearly(1)"  = Tearly1LN,
              "Teff(1)" = Teff1LN)

route2LN <- list("Tearly(2)"  = Tearly2LN,
               "Teff(2)" = Teff2LN)

route1t <- list("Tearly(1)"  = Tearly1t,
                 "Teff(1)" = Teff1t)

route2t <- list("Tearly(2)"  = Tearly2t,
                 "Teff(2)" = Teff2t)
r1LN <- Cell_Highlight_Plot(seurat_object = T8, cells_highlight = route1LN, pt.size = 2, highlight_color = c("#e28c33", "#e0652b")) +NoAxes()
r1t <- Cell_Highlight_Plot(seurat_object = T8, cells_highlight = route1t, pt.size = 2, highlight_color = c("#e28c33", "#e0652b")) +NoAxes()

r2LN <- Cell_Highlight_Plot(seurat_object = T8, cells_highlight = route2LN, pt.size = 2, highlight_color = c("#2DA049", "#1D6517")) +NoAxes()
r2t <- Cell_Highlight_Plot(seurat_object = T8, cells_highlight = route2t, pt.size = 2, highlight_color = c("#2DA049", "#1D6517")) +NoAxes()

plot(r1LN|r1t)
plot(r2LN|r2t)

```

## Figure 4H - alluvialplots

```{r}
# Circos plot between tissues
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(tibble)

col_T8_split = c(
  "LN_Tcentral mem(1)" =  "#edba40",
  "LN_Tearly act(1)" = "#e28c33",
  "LN_Teff(1)"  = "#e0652b",
  "LN_Tcentral mem(2)" = "#AED140",
  "LN_Tearly act(2)" =  "#2DA049",
  "LN_Teff(2)" = "#1D6517",
  "LN_Tlate act" = "#a9725A",
  "LN_Teff(3)" = "#009688",
  "LN_Tcytotoxic" =  "#00bcd4", 
  "LN_Texh(1)"= "#03a9f4" ,
  "LN_Texh(2)" = "#2196f3",
  "LN_Texh(3)" = "#3f51b5",
  "LN_Texh(4)" = "#673ab7" ,
  "LN_Tprolif" = "#9c27b0",
  "LN_Tmisc"= "#788176", 
  "LN_Tc17/MAIT" = "#f44336",
  
  "Tumor_Tcentral mem(1)" =  "#edba40",
  "Tumor_Tearly act(1)" = "#e28c33",
  "Tumor_Teff(1)"  = "#e0652b",
  "Tumor_Tcentral mem(2)" = "#AED140",
  "Tumor_Tearly act(2)" =  "#2DA049",
  "Tumor_Teff(2)" = "#1D6517",
  "Tumor_Tlate act" = "#a9725A",
  "Tumor_Teff(3)" = "#009688",
  "Tumor_Tcytotoxic" =  "#00bcd4", 
  "Tumor_Texh(1)"= "#03a9f4" ,
  "Tumor_Texh(2)" = "#2196f3",
  "Tumor_Texh(3)" = "#3f51b5",
  "Tumor_Texh(4)" = "#673ab7" ,
  "Tumor_Tprolif" = "#9c27b0",
  "Tumor_Tmisc"= "#788176", 
  "Tumor_Tc17/MAIT" = "#f44336"
) 

meta <- T8@meta.data
meta$Clonotype_patient <- meta$Clonotype_2
meta$cluster_annotation <- meta$CD8.Cell.Types


# Circos plot between tissues
meta_unique = meta %>%
  select(Clonotype_patient, cluster_annotation, tissue) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Clonotype_patient, "NA"))

meta_unique$cluster_annotation = as.character(meta_unique$cluster_annotation)
ln_clones = meta_unique %>%
  filter(tissue == "LN") %>%
  group_by(cluster_annotation) %>%
  summarise(clones = list(unique(Clonotype_patient))) %>%
  deframe()

tumor_clones = meta_unique %>%
  filter(tissue == "tumor") %>%
  group_by(cluster_annotation) %>%
  summarise(clones = list(unique(Clonotype_patient))) %>%
  deframe()

ln_names = names(ln_clones)
tumor_names = names(tumor_clones)

mat = outer(ln_names, tumor_names, Vectorize(function(a,b){
  length(intersect(ln_clones[[a]], tumor_clones[[b]]))
}))

rownames(mat) = paste0("LN_", ln_names)
colnames(mat) =  paste0("Tumor_", tumor_names)

sector_order = c(rownames(mat), colnames(mat))

circos.clear()
circos.par()

chordDiagram(mat, order = sector_order, annotationTrack = "grid", preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.05), reduce = 0,
             grid.col = col_T8_split)

circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x,y) {
  sector.name = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
  xlim = get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
  ylim = get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
  circos.text(mean(xlim), ylim[1] + .1, sector.name, facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE, adj = c(0.05,0))
}, bg.border = NA)


circos.clear()


# Circos plot within tissues 
ln_mat = outer(ln_names, ln_names, Vectorize(function(a,b){
  length(intersect(ln_clones[[a]], ln_clones[[b]]))
}))

diag(ln_mat) = 0
rownames(ln_mat) = colnames(ln_mat) = paste0("LN_", ln_names)

tumor_mat = outer(tumor_names, tumor_names, Vectorize(function(a,b){
  length(intersect(tumor_clones[[a]], tumor_clones[[b]]))
}))

diag(tumor_mat) = 0
rownames(tumor_mat) = colnames(tumor_mat) = paste0("Tumor_", tumor_names)

sector_order = c(rownames(ln_mat), rownames(tumor_mat))
full_mat = Matrix::bdiag(ln_mat, tumor_mat) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(full_mat) = colnames(full_mat) = sector_order


nL = nrow(ln_mat)
nT = nrow(tumor_mat)
gap_vec = c(rep(1, nL - 1), 20, rep(1, nT - 1), 20)


circos.clear()
circos.par(gap.degree = gap_vec)

chordDiagram(full_mat, order = sector_order, annotationTrack = "grid", preAllocateTracks = list(rack.height = 0.05), reduce = 0,
             grid.col = col_T8_split)

circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x,y) {
  sector.name = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
  xlim = get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
  ylim = get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
  circos.text(mean(xlim), ylim[1] + .1, sector.name, facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE, adj = c(0.05,0))
}, bg.border = NA)

```



## Figure 4I - route 1 vs route 2 vs mix vs other
```{r} 
# Figure 4I in graphad

df <- clones ## all clones / clones_route1 / clones_route2 / clones_mix / clones_other
# Extract row names
rownames_df <- rownames(df)

# Extract the patient number (before the underscore)
patient_ids <- sub("_.*", "", rownames_df)

# Count occurrences per patient
patient_counts <- table(patient_ids)

# Convert to a data frame
patient_counts_df <- as.data.frame(patient_counts)
colnames(patient_counts_df) <- c("PatientID", "RowCount")

```

### Figure S4B - Upset plot per patient and per tissue and patient distribution
```{r} 

# Assuming your dataframe is named T8@meta.data
df <- T8@meta.data

# Create a new column combining CD8.Cell.Types and tissue
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Cell_Tissue = paste0(CD8.Cell.Types, "_", tissue))

# Filter out rows with NA in Clonotype_2
df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Clonotype_2))

# Create a list of unique Cell_Tissue combinations and order them
unique_combinations <- c(
  "Tcentral mem(1)_LN", "Tcentral mem(1)_tumor", "Tcentral mem(2)_LN", "Tcentral mem(2)_tumor",
  "Tearly act(1)_LN", "Tearly act(1)_tumor", "Tearly act(2)_LN", "Tearly act(2)_tumor",
  "Tlate act_LN", "Tlate act_tumor", "Teff(1)_LN", "Teff(1)_tumor", "Teff(2)_LN", "Teff(2)_tumor",
  "Teff(3)_LN", "Teff(3)_tumor", "Tcytotoxic_LN", "Tcytotoxic_tumor", "Texh(1)_LN", "Texh(1)_tumor",
  "Texh(2)_LN", "Texh(2)_tumor", "Texh(3)_LN", "Texh(3)_tumor", "Texh(4)_LN", "Texh(4)_tumor",
  "Tprolif_LN", "Tprolif_tumor", "Tmisc_LN", "Tmisc_tumor", "Tc17/MAIT_LN", "Tc17/MAIT_tumor"
)

# Initialize a new dataframe with unique Clonotype_1 values as rownames and unique combinations as columns
result_df <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = length(unique(df_filtered$Clonotype_2)), 
                               ncol = length(unique_combinations) + 3)) # check if you add more columns
rownames(result_df) <- unique(df_filtered$Clonotype_2)
colnames(result_df) <- c(unique_combinations, "Frequency", "Patient", "overlap") # bepaal welke columns je erbij wil

# Fill the dataframe with summed values and add Frequency column
for (i in 1:nrow(df_filtered)) {
  if (!is.na(df_filtered$Cell_Tissue[i])) {
    result_df[df_filtered$Clonotype_2[i], df_filtered$Cell_Tissue[i]] <- result_df[df_filtered$Clonotype_2[i], df_filtered$Cell_Tissue[i]] + 1
  }
  result_df[df_filtered$Clonotype_2[i], "Frequency"] <- df_filtered$Frequency_2[i]
  result_df[df_filtered$Clonotype_2[i], "Patient"] <- df_filtered$patient_true[i]
  result_df[df_filtered$Clonotype_2[i], "overlap"] <- df_filtered$overlap_2[i]
}

### SHARED CLONES
dfshared <- result_df %>%
  filter(overlap == "Y") %>%
  filter(Frequency>2)

upset(dfshared, unique_combinations,
      n_intersections = 20,
      base_annotations=list(
        'Intersection size'=intersection_size(
          counts=T,
          mapping=aes(fill=Patient)
        ))) + 
  ggtitle("All shared clones top20")



## LOCALLY EXPANDED CLONES
dfnon <- result_df %>%
  filter(overlap == "N") %>%
  filter(Frequency >1)

upset(dfnon, unique_combinations,
      n_intersections = 20,
      base_annotations=list(
        'Intersection size'=intersection_size(
          counts=T,
          mapping=aes(fill=Patient))
      )) + 
  ggtitle("All non-shared clones top20")


```


## Fig S4C - route 1/2/crossover/other
```{r} 
# Figure S4C in graphad

df <- clones ## all clones / clones_route1 / clones_route2 / clones_mix / clones_other
# Extract row names
rownames_df <- rownames(df)

# Extract the patient number (before the underscore)
patient_ids <- sub("_.*", "", rownames_df)

# Count occurrences per patient
patient_counts <- table(patient_ids)

# Convert to a data frame
patient_counts_df <- as.data.frame(patient_counts)
colnames(patient_counts_df) <- c("PatientID", "RowCount")
```
